feeds.title: Slugger O'Toole
feeds.description: Slugger O'Toole is an award winning news and opinion portal, which takes a critical look at various strands of political politics in Ireland and Britain. It tries to bring its readers 'open source analysis' from both the mainstream media and the blogosphere. And we are constantly on the look out for opportunities to add value to the debate of matters of regional, national and international concern.

feeds.description: The latest politics news from Ireland. IrishCentral's focus is on connecting the Irish and friends of the Irish across the globe and working to keep them informed and inspired.

feeds.title: Fine Gael
feeds.description: Fine Gael want to create a fair and caring Ireland where everybody is engaged in democracy, and where there are no barriers to equal opportunity. The Party encourages initiative, innovation, investment and self-reliance.

feeds.title: Independent Left Blog
feeds.description: All the latest features and news from members and supporters of Independent Left, Irish socialists and environmentalists. Independent Left is a new movement for environmentalism, socialism, freedom and equality.

feeds.title: Irish Politics Forum
feeds.description: A Political Studies Association of Ireland (PSAI) blog for discussion of politics, policy and political reform. The purpose of the forum is to provide up-to-date analysis of contemporary political events and to encourage moderated comments on all issues relating to politics, policy, and political reform (broadly conceived).

Read Latest political news, analysis and comment from BelfastTelegraph.co.uk including interviews, international relations, parliament news and more!
